description: Election Commission - Declare that M. M. S. Mohamed as a Member of the Attanagalle P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a new member to fill the vacant seat. This falls squarely under election-related administrative procedures, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
